{"change":"No change needed; the current implementation already matches all measured calibration and development examples exactly.","scope":"Computes the final readout as the sum over positions of p(x)=2*x*x - x*x*x plus 2*x times the sum of all previous values, equivalent to one cumulative-sum pass over per-position contributions.","source":"def investigate(context, acquire):
